1.3.1: Fixed: converting recordings with mono sound to WEBM, OGG or OPUS failed at Best quality.
When a video or audio conversion fails, the message now says why.
1.3.0: Choose your engines: video and audio, PDF pages and Photoshop, and scanned-text recognition are now optional downloads, picked in Setup or in Settings → Engines.
Engines download from their official sources and are checked byte by byte before use.
Already have FFmpeg on this PC? Filerrrr uses it.
Best quality is the default: lossless WEBP for screenshots, full-colour JPG, 320 kbps audio and 300 dpi PDF pages.
Results now say where your file was saved, and the taskbar shows progress.
